jobs.title: Director Information Management
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Who are you?

The Director, Information Management will lead the Information Management practice across the Infrastructure Segment in Canada, overseeing the core capability streams of BIM, GIS/Digital Twin, and Document Control. This role is responsible for ensuring strategic alignment, integration, and governance across supporting digital services including Program Management Information Systems (PMIS) and Data Engineering.

The successful candidate will also serve as the Information Management Lead on a major aviation program, overseeing Document Control, BIM, and PMIS functions while providing executive-level client engagement and strategic leadership. This role combines major program delivery, service line leadership, and digital transformation to enhance organizational capabilities and market presence.

Job Description

Program & Practice Leadership

Lead and manage BIM, GIS/Digital Twin, and Document Control capability streams, including team leadership, resource management, and performance oversight.
Provide strategic direction and integration across PMIS and Data Engineering functions.
Develop and implement Information Management strategies and Target Operating Models (TOMs) for major infrastructure and aviation programs.
Support digital business growth through business development, proposal support, commercial management, budgeting, and service line development.
Drive innovation and promote information management best practices across clients, project teams, and supply chain partners.

Governance, Lifecycle Delivery & Assurance

Govern the complete information lifecycle from requirements definition through operational handover.
Establish and maintain information governance frameworks, including OIR, AIR, PIR, EIR, and BIM Execution Plans (BEPs).
Lead digital twin and asset information strategies integrating BIM, GIS, reality capture, and enterprise asset management systems.
Direct supply chain assessments, quality audits, and compliance with ISO 19650 standards, including security requirements.
Develop executive-level reporting, analytics, and dashboards that provide visibility into key information management metrics and program performance.
Ensure successful asset information verification and structured handover to operational environments including CAFM, IWMS, and EAM platforms.

Qualifications

12+ years of Information Management, Digital Engineering, BIM, or related infrastructure experience.
5+ years leading multi-disciplinary teams and digital delivery functions.
Strong experience with BIM, GIS/Digital Twin, Document Control, PMIS, and Data Engineering.
Expertise in information governance, TOMs, OIR/AIR/PIR/EIR, and asset information management.
Deep knowledge of ISO 19650 standards and digital delivery best practices.
Experience advising executive-level stakeholders and clients.
Professional designation (P.Eng., PMP, or IM certification) is an asset.
Experience within aviation, transit, or major P3/alliance environments preferred.

jobs.title: Director of AI
jobs.description:
About Apply

APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com .

LOCATION:
APPLY is hybrid/remote friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in Canada, working in hours that align to ET (Eastern Timezone) or PT (Pacific Timezone).

THE ROLE:

Are you an experienced AI engineering leader who can turn complex business problems into reliable, production-ready AI solutions? Do you enjoy working directly with clients while staying close enough to the technology to shape architectures, guide engineers, and resolve critical delivery challenges?

APPLY is seeking a Director of AI to lead the design and delivery of AI-enabled products and platforms across client engagements. This senior, client-facing role combines AI and software engineering expertise with consulting judgment, product thinking, and technical leadership.

You will help clients move from AI ambition to working solutions—from identifying valuable opportunities and rapidly validating ideas to engineering, deploying, and operating secure, scalable AI applications. You will serve as a senior technical authority while contributing hands-on expertise through architecture, prototyping, technical reviews, and delivery oversight.

You will also help advance APPLY’s AI engineering capability by developing reusable patterns, standards, accelerators, and delivery practices.

Responsibilities

Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and delivery of AI applications from discovery and experimentation through production and scale.
Work with client executives, product leaders, architects, and engineering teams to identify valuable AI opportunities and translate them into achievable technical roadmaps.
Design AI applications that combine models, enterprise data, APIs, software components, user experiences, and human workflows.
Guide the implementation of agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, enterprise search, predictive models, and AI capabilities embedded in digital products.
Determine when to use deterministic software, machine learning, large language models, human review, or a combination of approaches.
Establish evaluation-driven development practices, including test datasets, error analysis, deterministic checks, model-based evaluation, and business outcome measurement.
Ensure solutions meet production requirements for reliability, observability, scalability, latency, maintainability, security, and cost.
Guide practices for CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, monitoring, tracing, regression testing, and ongoing optimization.
Provide hands-on technical leadership through prototyping, architecture reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, and delivery oversight.
Use AI-assisted development and coding agents effectively while maintaining appropriate verification, security, and human oversight.
Support proposals, discovery workshops, solution design, estimates, and executive presentations.
Develop reusable AI engineering patterns, reference architectures, accelerators, and delivery standards.
Contribute to hiring, technical mentorship, and the continued growth of APPLY’s AI capability.

Requirements

10+ years of experience across software engineering, data engineering, machine learning, or related technology disciplines, including significant experience leading AI or ML solutions.
Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating AI or machine learning applications in production—not only proofs of concept.
Strong software engineering foundation, including system design, APIs, data architecture, testing, security, cloud infrastructure, and production operations.
Hands-on proficiency in Python and experience with modern application, data, and AI engineering frameworks.
Strong understanding of LLMs, RAG, context engineering, agentic workflows, tool use, structured outputs, and model evaluation.
Experience grounding AI systems in enterprise data, including structured data, documents, semantic models, vector stores, or knowledge graphs.
Experience establishing evaluation and error-analysis practices for systems with probabilistic outputs.
Ability to balance model quality, reliability, latency, cost, security, and user experience.
Experience with cloud-native architecture and production deployment on GCP, AWS, or Azure.
Familiarity with containers, CI/CD, observability, and MLOps or LLMOps practices.
Demonstrated success in a consulting, professional-services, or complex client-facing environment.
Ability to move comfortably between executive conversations, product decisions, architecture discussions, and detailed technical problem-solving.
Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
A degree in computer science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, data science, or a related field—or equivalent professional experience.

NICE TO HAVES

Experience delivering AI solutions in regulated, privacy-sensitive, or large-scale enterprise environments.
Experience with model fine-tuning, open-source models, multimodal AI, voice agents, or computer-use agents.
Experience implementing enterprise AI security controls, including prompt-injection defenses, tool permissions, and human approval gates.
Experience building internal AI platforms, reusable agent frameworks, or developer enablement capabilities.
Experience contributing to organizational AI strategy, operating models, or technical standards.
Professional certifications or significant delivery experience with GCP, Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable platforms.

LIFE AT APPLY

People are at the core of everything we do at APPLY. We provide you with modern tools, systems and approaches, value your time, safety, and health, and strive to build a work community where you can thrive and grow. Here are a few benefits we offer to support you:

Agentic Delivery:
Our people work in a modern way to deliver client outcomes. Broaden your skills on a range of engagements with international brands that have a global impact.

An inclusive and safe environment:
We’re truly committed to building a culture where you are celebrated and everyone feels welcome and safe.

AI & Strategic Upskilling:
Accelerate your professional growth with generous training budgets and mentorship, with a specific focus on Agentic AI expertise and the critical human skills required for the future of work.

Generous vacation policy:
Work-life balance is key to our team’s success, so we offer flexible personal time off (PTO); allowing ample time away from work to promote overall well-being.

Customizable benefits:
Tailor your extended health and dental plan to your needs, priorities, and preferences.

Flexible work arrangements:
We work in a variety of ways, from remote, to in-office, to a blend of both.

APPLY is a safe, respectful, and inclusive community where differences are celebrated. We are committed to equal opportunity and fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. Learn more in our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) section. For recruitment accommodations, please email [email protected] .

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Compensation: $130- $150k

Location: Toronto (Hybrid)

About Statflo

Statflo is the business texting platform that helps front-line teams at telecom, financial services, and retail companies have personalized, compliant, one-to-one conversations with customers at scale. Our mission is simple: Make every rep your best rep.

Today, Statflo powers more than 30 million conversations a year for enterprise clients, backed by built-in compliance safeguards (TCPA, CTIA, CASL, SOC 2) and deep integrations into our customers' existing systems.We're a remote-first company of 40+ people headquartered in downtown Toronto, and we operate by four principles: Be Accountable, Be Results-Driven, Be Curious, and Be Kaizen (continuous improvement, every day). We hire smart, capable people and trust them to do their best work.

What is the Opportunity?

Statflo is hiring its first Director of Finance — a senior, hands-on leader who will own finance for the company as we scale. You'll be the most senior (and, initially, only) member of the finance function, acting as a strategic partner to the CEO, board, lenders, and shareholders, while also supporting key operational functions including RevOps and Salesforce administration.

We plan to hire a Controller within the next twelve months to own day-to-day data entry and transactional accounting, but that hire hasn't happened yet — so this role requires a genuine willingness to roll up your sleeves and get into the details until that support is in place. This is a rare opportunity to build a finance and ops function largely from the ground up, shape it in your own image, and grow into a broader leadership role as the company scales.

You Will Be Able To

Strategic Finance

Serve as Statflo's senior finance voice with the board, management team, lenders, and shareholders — preparing board materials, financial updates, and ad hoc analyses that inform key decisions
Own the company's financial projection model and cash-runway model, keeping them current, accurate, and stress-tested against multiple scenarios
Lead financial planning & analysis (FP&A): budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and monthly/quarterly reporting for the leadership team and board
Manage relationships with lenders and support debt covenant compliance and reporting
Support fundraising, financing, and other strategic transactions as needed, including data room management and due diligence
Track and report on core SaaS metrics — ARR, CARR, MRR, gross revenue retention (GRR), and net revenue retention (NRR) — and translate them into insights that shape pricing, packaging, and go-to-market decisions
Own cap table management and equity administration

Hands-On Finance

Support the monthly close process, including journal entries, reconciliations, and reporting
Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, and billing/collections
Ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial statements and tax filings (working with external accountants as needed)

Operations

Support Revenue Operations (RevOps): sales forecasting (as part of the projection model), quote-to-cash processes, and commission/comp plan administration
Administer and continuously improve Salesforce (or partner closely with an admin/consultant) to ensure the CRM supports accurate reporting and clean data across sales, marketing, and customer success
Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and insurance, and support legal/compliance matters in coordination with outside counsel
Identify and implement systems and process improvements across finance and ops as the company scales

Team Building

Define the hiring plan for a Controller and other future finance hires; lead the search, hire, and onboard that person
Build the processes, systems, and controls that will let the finance/ops function scale smoothly as the team grows

What you need to Succeed?

7–10+ years of progressive finance experience, including meaningful time as a Controller or in a similarly senior accounting/finance role, and you're ready to take the next step into a strategic, cross-functional leadership seat
Strong SaaS industry background, with fluency in ARR, CARR, MRR, GRR, and NRR, and a solid understanding of how these metrics connect to unit economics and business strategy
Direct experience building and owning financial projection and cash-runway models
Experience preparing for and presenting to a board of directors, and ideally direct experience working with lenders and/or shareholders/investors
A genuine willingness to be hands-on with day-to-day transactional work in the near term, balanced with the judgment to operate strategically
Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy and ambiguity in a startup/scale-up environment, with strong prioritization skills across a broad mandate
CPA (or equivalent) designation preferred, not required
Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex financial and operational information for a range of audiences, from the board to first-line managers

Why Join Us?

Competitive Benefits: Healthcare Spending Account (HSA) and Medical & Dental
Hybrid Work options: Work two days a week from our downtown Toronto office, located by Union Station.
High-Impact Product: Work on a proprietary platform trusted by industry giants that directly powers millions of meaningful customer interactions.
People-First Culture: We invest heavily in our team’s growth, creativity, and well-being. Your ideas move the needle here, not corporate red tape.
Innovation & Ownership: Tackle complex engineering, product, and go-to-market challenges in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where you own your results.
Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy the energy of a top-tier Toronto tech company with supportive remote and hybrid options designed for life balance.

If you thrive in a culture of curiosity, execution, and genuine connection, we’d love to build what's next together!

Whats Our Interview Process?

Initial Phone screen with our Recruiter
Conversation with CRO and a member of the board
Conversations with Head of Finance

Interested? Send us your resume, and if your profile looks like a match, we’ll be in touch soon.

At Statflo, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace where every individual is valued and respected. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against any applicant or employee based on race, ancestry,place of origin, color, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed,sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender

expression, age, marital status, family status, disability,or any other characteristic protected by the Ontario Human Rights Code.

Statflo is committed to providing accommodations throughout the recruitment process in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). If you require accommodation at any stage of

the hiring process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

jobs.title: Technology Lead, Enterprise Platforms & Operation (Director)
jobs.description:
Venture outside the ordinary - TMX Careers

The TMX group of companies includes leading global exchanges such as the Toronto Stock Exchange, Montreal Exchange, and numerous innovative organizations enhancing capital markets. United as a global team, we’re connecting cross-functionally, traversing industries and geographies, moving opportunity into action, advancing global economic growth, and propelling progress. Through a rich exchange of ideas, meaningful collaboration, and a nimble operating model, we're powering some of the nation's most critical systems, fueling capital formation and innovation, bringing increased opportunity to business visionaries, product ingenuity to consumers, and career exploration to our team.

Ready to be part of the action?

We are seeking a strategic, highly collaborative technology leader to take comprehensive ownership of our enterprise platforms and corporate ecosystem. As the Technology Lead, Enterprise Platforms and Operations
, you will drive a holistic strategy to modernize our digital workplace, transforming disconnected processes and siloed applications into an integrated, frictionless employee experience.

Grounded in a workflow-first methodology, you will champion operational excellence across core productivity suites, workflow automation, custom web tools, and emerging AI technologies. You will act as the organizational "switchboard," bridging technical teams and executive business partners to ensure our technology portfolio directly enables business capabilities, scales efficiency, and delivers maximum ROI.

This role reports to: Head of Corporate Technology Services
Job Location: Hybrid (2-3 days in office) - based in Toronto, ON (100 Adelaide St W)

Key Accountabilities:

Strategic Leadership & Platform Governance: Define and execute a multi-year strategic vision for core enterprise platforms—including Google Workspace, ServiceNow, Web/Digital platforms, desktop applications, and Gemini/AI initiatives. Establish governance, lifecycle management, and security guardrails in partnership with Cybersecurity and Risk teams.
Ecosystem Synergy & Debt Reduction: Architect seamless integrations across disparate systems to remove operational friction, eliminate redundant applications, and systematically reduce technical debt. Map platform capabilities directly to business capabilities and the service catalog.
Process Orchestration & Automation: Function as the central architect for workflow design, ensuring business processes are thoroughly re-engineered before applying automation to high-volume or high-friction areas.
Service Management & Analytics: Establish and enforce rigorous Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Build data-driven performance dashboards to monitor platform health, user adoption rates, and license utilization to hold service owners strictly accountable.
Stakeholder Engagement & Change Management: Partner closely with Technology Leaders, HRIS/Finance Directors, and shared IT service teams to align platform roadmaps with business goals. Collaborate with HR and Internal Communications to drive adoption and training campaigns.
Vendor & Budget Optimization: Direct strategic vendor relationships, negotiate contracts, and align software roadmaps (including disruptive AI capabilities) to optimize SaaS spend and realize strong ROI.
Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and empower a high-performing team of platform managers, API developers, and technical specialists, fostering a culture of accountability, continuous upskilling, and innovation.

Must Have(s):

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field (Master’s or MBA preferred).
Overall Experience: 10 to 12+ years of progressive leadership experience within IT operations, enterprise applications, or workplace technology environments.
People Management: 5+ years of dedicated experience leading and mentoring high-performing software engineering or platform management teams.
Platform Mastery: Proven track record of managing enterprise-scale deployments of core platforms such as Google Workspace, ServiceNow (ITSM/ITOM), and Enterprise ERP environments.
Modern Technical Acumen: Deep familiarity with web architectures, API integrations, desktop application management, and agile product management workflows.
Emerging Tech Proficiency: Practical experience integrating emerging AI tools, prompt engineering, and machine learning capabilities into existing enterprise suites.
Strategic & Financial Mindset: Strong capabilities in budget oversight, vendor management, process optimization, and executive-level stakeholder management.

Nice to Have(s):

Experience managing IT platform transformation within global or multi-office enterprise environments.
Advanced certifications in ServiceNow, Google Workspace Administration, or ITIL Frameworks.

Salary Range:
$160,000K/year - $180,000K/year CAD. Please note that the salary range included is a guideline only. The salary offered may vary based on factors, including, but not limited to, the successful candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, and experience.

The recruiting efforts for this role are intended to fill a vacant position.

In the market for…

Excitement
- Explore emerging technology and innovation, as well as ventures and digital finance that shape the future of global markets! Experience the movement of the market while grounded in the stability of close to 200 years of success.

Connection
- With site hubs in some of the world’s most multicultural cities, we leverage our size and structure to create rich connections and belonging while experiencing powerful global impact through our work.

Impact
- More than a platform, we use our talents to power mission-critical systems that drive global economic advancement, innovation, and growth. As well, our employee-led Team Impact spreads social good via our giving strategy.

Wellness
- From empathetic leadership to a culture of flexibility and balance, we believe wellness at work creates the maximum yield and a stronger “we”. Plus, with a cloud-first and hybrid workstyle, as well as generous time-off and leaves, we support a life well lived!

Growth
- From a growth mindset in our work, to expansion in our business, TMX is home to action-takers energized by the achievement of ambitious growth.

Ready to enrich your career with impactful work, leaders who truly care, and the flexibility and programs to help you thrive as part of #TeamTMX ? Apply now.

Please note that our company is not currently sponsoring work permit applications and the applicant must be authorized to work in the country where this position is located.

TMX is committed to creating and sustaining a collegial work environment in which all individuals are treated with dignity and respect and one which reflects the diversity of the community in which we operate. We provide accommodations for applicants and employees who require it .

jobs.description:

FENCECORE
est un fournisseur canadien de services TI gérés. Nous accompagnons les entreprises de taille moyenne dans leurs opérations TI, leur cybersécurité, leur conformité, leur infrastructure infonuagique, leur hébergement privé et leur soutien technique. Nous grandissons rapidement et voulons automatiser davantage notre façon de travailler.

Le défi

Beaucoup de fournisseurs de services TI dépendent encore des billets, de quelques personnes clés et de connaissances peu documentées. Nous misons plutôt sur l'automatisation, l'IA et la rigueur en ingénierie. Nous cherchons la personne qui mènera ce changement.

À titre de directeur ou directrice de la technologie, vous dirigerez nos gestionnaires et nos équipes techniques. Ces équipes couvrent les Services gérés, la Sécurité, la Conformité, l'Hébergement privé, le Centre de services et la Livraison de projets, et servent un portefeuille grandissant de clients de taille moyenne. Vous serez responsable de la qualité des services et de leur rentabilité, soit la marge brute, le taux d'utilisation et l'efficacité. Vous serez aussi le dernier recours pour les dossiers les plus critiques et dirigerez concrètement nos projets d'automatisation et d'IA.

Ce que vous prendrez en charge

Livraison et qualité :
Diriger les six lignes de service par l'intermédiaire de vos gestionnaires. Définir des normes de qualité claires et les faire respecter. Prendre en charge les problèmes techniques les plus complexes et les situations clients qui exigent un dirigeant, assurer le suivi et corriger la cause à la source.
Automatisation et IA :
Bâtir vous-même notre modèle axé sur l'automatisation. Vous rédigerez les scripts, créerez les intégrations et les mettrez en production. Vous relierez nos plateformes RMM, PSA, de sécurité et infonuagiques à l'aide d'API, de webhooks et de code versionné. Vous automatiserez la surveillance, le triage, la remédiation et les rapports, et utiliserez l'IA là où elle apporte un réel avantage.
Sécurité et conformité :
Définir les exigences de sécurité pour FENCECORE et ses clients. La personne responsable de la cybersécurité s'occupe du travail concret et de SOC 2. Vous fixez les priorités et lui donnez les moyens d'agir.
Portefeuille de services :
Maintenir des offres pertinentes, bien tarifées et rentables, et décider quoi créer, acheter ou retirer.
Performance financière :
Rendre visibles en temps réel la marge brute, le taux d'utilisation et l'efficacité de chaque ligne de service. Les améliorer chaque trimestre et assurer une croissance rentable.

Votre première année.
Après 12 mois :
Les tâches courantes les plus fréquentes sont automatisées, et les prochaines priorités sont établies
Les dossiers transmis à la direction se règlent plus vite, et leurs causes sont corrigées
Les rapports opérationnels et clients sont disponibles en temps réel, sans course de fin de mois
La marge brute et le taux d'utilisation ont augmenté de façon mesurable
L'équipe de livraison est plus rapide et structurée pour la croissance
Une feuille de route sur 12 à 24 mois précise quoi créer, acheter ou retirer

Ce que vous apporterez

Gestion de services TI :
Vous avez dirigé des gestionnaires et des équipes techniques chez un fournisseur de services TI gérés ou dans les services TI, tout en gardant votre crédibilité technique.
Compétences techniques (essentielles) :
PowerShell, Python, API REST, contrôle de version et gestion complète des intégrations. S'ajoute une utilisation pratique des outils à faible code et d'IA.
Rigueur opérationnelle :
Vous utilisez des indicateurs, des tableaux de bord et des suivis réguliers qui donnent des résultats. Vous avez aussi la fermeté nécessaire pour prendre des décisions organisationnelles difficiles.
Aplomb sous pression :
Vous avez déjà redressé des situations avec des clients insatisfaits et rétabli leur confiance. Vous communiquez clairement, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.
Sécurité et conformité (essentielles) :
Cadres, contrôles, menaces actuelles, SOC 2 et exigences des assureurs en cybersécurité.
Bilinguisme :
Maîtrise de l'anglais et du français pour diriger les équipes et gérer les situations clients dans les deux langues.

Pourquoi vous joindre à nous?

Diriger l'organisation tout en la transformant, une combinaison rare
Un véritable mandat de changement, avec le soutien pour le mener à bien
Un impact direct : vos automatisations sont en production et vos normes définissent notre réputation
Une rémunération et des avantages concurrentiels, alignés sur la performance et l'impact

*****
FENCECORE
is a Canadian MSP delivering proactive IT operations, cybersecurity, compliance, cloud infrastructure, private hosting, and high-touch support to mid-market businesses. We're scaling fast and building a smarter, more automated delivery organization.

The Opportunity

Most MSPs run on tickets, heroics, and tribal knowledge. We're rebuilding ours around automation, AI, and engineering discipline, and we're hiring the leader who will make it happen.

As Director of Technology, you'll lead our managers and technical staff across Managed Services, Security, Compliance, Private Hosting, Service Desk, and Project Delivery, serving a growing portfolio of mid-market customers. You'll own service quality and the economics of delivery: gross margin, utilization, and efficiency. You'll be the final escalation point, and you'll lead our automation and AI transformation hands-on.

What You'll Own

Delivery and quality:
Run all six service lines through your managers. Set the standard and hold it. Own the toughest technical problems and senior customer escalations, close the loop, and turn every escalation into a permanent fix.
Automation and AI:
Build our automation-first operating model yourself. You'll write the scripts, build the integrations, and ship to production. You'll connect our RMM, PSA, security, and cloud platforms with APIs, webhooks, and version-controlled code. You'll automate monitoring, triage, remediation, and reporting, and use AI where it earns its place.
Security and compliance:
Set the security bar for Fencecore and our clients. Our Senior Cybersecurity Specialist owns hands-on security work and SOC 2 execution. You provide direction, priority, and backing.
Service portfolio:
Keep our offerings sharp, well priced, and profitable, and decide what we build, buy, or retire.
Business performance:
Make gross margin, utilization, and efficiency by service line visible in real time. Improve them every quarter and build a model that scales profitably.

Your First Year.
By month twelve:
The highest-volume routine work runs through automation in production, with a clear pipeline of what's next
Escalations resolve faster, with root causes engineered out
Operational and customer reporting is real-time, with no month-end scramble
Gross margin and utilization are measurably up
The delivery team is faster and structured for the next stage of growth
A 12–24 month roadmap sets out what we build, buy, or retire

What You'll Bring

MSP delivery leadership:
You've led managers and technical teams in an MSP or IT-services environment and kept your technical credibility.
An engineer's toolkit (required):
PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, version control, and end-to-end integration ownership. You also use low-code and AI tools practically.
Operating rigour:
You use metrics, scorecards, and cadences that drive results, and you have the spine to make difficult organizational calls.
Presence under pressure:
You've turned unhappy customers around and rebuilt confidence with owners and executives. You communicate clearly, in the room and in writing.
Security and compliance depth (required):
Frameworks, controls, the current threat landscape, SOC 2, and cyber-insurance requirements.
Bilingual fluency:
English and French, to lead teams and handle escalations in both.

Why Join Us

Run the organization and rebuild it, a rare combination
A genuine mandate for change, with the air cover to see it through
Direct impact: your automation ships to production, and your standards define our reputation
Competitive compensation and benefits aligned to performance and impact

We Are Banking At Another Level.

Choosing BDC as your employer
means working in a healthy, inclusive, and skilled workplace that puts forward the best conditions to bring together unique teams where employees are empowered to act. In addition to paid vacation each year, five personal days, sick days as necessary, and our offices are closed from December 25 to January 1
A hybrid work model that truly balances work and personal life
Opportunities for learning, training and development, and much more...

Explore the BDC Way in our Culture Book

Position Overview

BDC views data and AI as critical enterprise assets and capabilities that must be managed, governed and continuously evolved to create value for Canadian entrepreneurs and for the organization. Reporting to the Chief Data and AI Officer, the AVP, Data & AI is a senior Data Office leader accountable for building and leading the capability chapters that enable BDC’s data, analytics and AI ambitions.

This role is a leader of leaders. The incumbent leads, coaches and aligns Chapter Leads, SMEs and Delivery Leads across core capability areas, including Data Engineering, Analytics & BI Engineering, Advanced Analytics & AI, and Intelligent Automation. The AVP establishes the leadership routines, standards, talent practices and capability roadmaps required to develop high-performing chapters and to ensure that expertise is deployed effectively in support of enterprise priorities.

The AVP is also responsible for supporting and shaping the technical vision for their sphere of expertise. In close collaboration with the CDAIO, IT leaders, Product/Program Delivery Managers, Data & AI Governance, business partners, risk, legal and compliance stakeholders, the incumbent ensures that technical direction, architecture choices, engineering standards and delivery practices are coherent, scalable, secure and aligned with BDC’s transformation agenda.

The role enables delivery units and squads, including Horizon / Data Hub Platform and AI Transformation initiatives, by ensuring they have access to the right chapter capabilities, technical guidance, reusable patterns and delivery support. The AVP champions a culture where data and AI are treated as enterprise capabilities, where teams are empowered by clear guardrails, and where analytics, automation and AI generate tangible business outcomes while managing risk appropriately.

The incumbent is expected to be a visible champion of collaboration, technical excellence, pragmatic innovation and BDC’s cultural norms. They must build trusted relationships across the organization and translate strategic priorities into capability development, execution discipline and measurable value.

CHALLENGES TO BE MET

Leadership and capability chapters

Lead, coach and develop Chapter Leads and senior specialists responsible for Data Engineering, Analytics & BI Engineering, Advanced Analytics & AI, and Intelligent Automation capabilities.
Establish clear chapter mandates, leadership routines, capability roadmaps, talent plans, communities of practice and performance expectations for each capability area.
Create the conditions for technical leaders to scale their expertise across squads and initiatives rather than operating as isolated delivery resources.
Build a strong culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and pragmatic delivery excellence.

Technical vision, standards and architecture alignment

Support the CDAIO in defining and communicating the technical vision for data, analytics, AI and automation capabilities within the Data Office.
Partner with IT architecture, security, risk, privacy, governance and platform leaders to ensure that solution patterns, technology choices and engineering practices are scalable, secure, sustainable and aligned with enterprise standards.
Oversee the evolution of technical standards, reusable patterns, delivery playbooks, data and AI engineering practices, and quality expectations across chapters.
Provide senior technical guidance and decision support for priority initiatives, including Data Hub / platform modernization, AI Transformation and intelligent automation capabilities.

Delivery enablement and enterprise value

Ensure squads and delivery teams have access to the right chapter capabilities, technical expertise and delivery support to execute roadmap priorities.
Collaborate with PDMs, business partners and transformation leaders to translate business outcomes into practical capability needs, sequencing decisions and delivery plans.
Enable analytics, BI, AI and automation solutions that improve decision-making, client experience, operational efficiency and risk management.
Identify opportunities to leverage internal and external data, structured and unstructured information, analytics and AI to create measurable value for BDC and Canadian entrepreneurs.

Governance partnership and operating model maturity

Work in close partnership with the Data & AI Governance leader to ensure technical delivery practices support responsible data use, data quality, stewardship, policy, controls and model or algorithm governance expectations.
Promote data literacy and technical fluency across stakeholders by explaining trade-offs, delivery implications and capability maturity in business terms.
Contribute to the evolution of the Data Office operating model, including chapter/squad ways of working, intake, prioritization, technical reviews and adoption routines.
Champion BDC’s mission, values and cultural norms while building trusted relationships with IT, Digital, Risk, Legal, Compliance and business units.

What We Are Looking For

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in business administration, computer science, engineering, data science, information systems, analytics or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
Extensive senior leadership experience in data, analytics, AI, automation, enterprise architecture, technology delivery or a related transformation environment.

Experience supporting large data, analytics, BI, AI, automation or platform modernization programs, including delivery through squads, chapters, communities of practice or agile operating models.
Strong stakeholder management experience, with the ability to influence executives, technology leaders, risk/control partners and business teams.
Banking, financial services, risk, regulatory, privacy or responsible AI experience is a strong asset.

There has never been a more important time to lead information security in higher education. . This is more than an information security leadership role. Reporting to the Chief Digital Officer, you will provide strategic leadership for the College's cybersecurity program, overseeing governance, risk management, security operations, incident response, compliance, and cybersecurity awareness while serving as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and the Board of Governors.

As our Associate Director, Information Security, you'll play a critical role in protecting the College's digital future while helping advance one of Canada's leading post-secondary institutions.

Lead the College's cybersecurity strategy, governance, and risk management framework.
Advise senior leaders on cybersecurity risks, priorities, and emerging threats.
Provide cybersecurity reporting and guidance to leadership and governance bodies.

Strengthen Cybersecurity Operations & Organizational Resilience

Advance Compliance, Risk Management & Continuous Improvement

Lead audits, assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Build Strategic Partnership & Serve as Trusted Advisor
